Not a hound. The rumor of one — the feeling of being followed home, given teeth.
Every spilled thought pools somewhere. Down here, it pools into this.
Memories nobody kept. They whisper names at you, hoping one of them is theirs.
Drawn to light. There is no light down here, so it is drawn to you.
The Umbral Hound, after it caught up with someone.
Every bad dream ever woken from, knotted together. It wants to finish them.
It has been looking up for a long time, waiting for something to fall.
Gloam that sat still long enough to crystallize, then got up again.
A soldier of a city whose name fell out of every book at once. Still on patrol.
A town gate that forgot it was a gate and remembered only that it was supposed to keep people out.
It still lights the lamps on its street every evening. There is no street.
It carried the news of the city's fall to no one. It is still looking for someone to tell.
A saint whose miracle nobody wrote down. The statue lost its face out of sheer politeness.
It burned the archive. It does not remember why, which is the only funny thing about it.
Sworn to a lord nobody remembers, against an enemy nobody remembers, forever.
It spins its webs out of unread pages. You can read a sentence or two in them, if you get close. Don't.
The very first winter had wolves in it. Nobody was alive to remember them. They noticed.
The light off snow on a morning no one saw.
Slow as a glacier. Exactly as slow. It is very proud of this.
The first thaw. It has been waiting for spring since before there were seasons.
It froze at its post. It is still at its post. Some promises are just weather.
Watching the snow fall. Has never once blinked. Would like to.
Its wingbeats are the reason snow drifts. It is not sorry.
Frozen mid-reach. It thawed just enough to finish the motion.
